title: Embalmed visceral material multidisciplinary analysis
protocol: Sample tissue such that one to five percent of the total weight is collected, with a minimum of 2 grams.
Use decontaminated or sterile surgery instruments for sampling.
Conduct preliminary macroscopic examination using binocular lenses at magnifications of ×20 and ×40.
Rehydrate and decalcify 0.1 gram of sample in a solution of 10% NaCl diluted in pure water plus 100 μL of 100% acetic acid for 30 minutes.
Sample 200 μL from the supernatant.
Centrifuge the liquid at 1000 turns per minute for 10 minutes.
Place one spot per slide (Superfrost®) to obtain a total of four slides.
Color two slides using the Hematein-Eosin-Saffran technique (HES).
Prepare two additional slides for further cyto-immuno-chemistry analysis.
Perform antigen retrieval according to laboratory recommendations for primary antibodies.
Wash slides in de-ionised water.
Neutralize endogenous peroxydase using peroxydase block for 5 minutes.
Wash slides in TBS for 2 × 5 minutes.
Incubate with protein block for 5 minutes.
Wash slides in TBS for 2 × 5 minutes.
Incubate with optimally diluted primary antibodies according to the laboratory recommendations.
Wash slides in TBS for 2 × 5 minutes.
Incubate with post-primary block for 30 minutes.
Wash slides in TBS for 2 × 5 minutes with gentle rocking.
Incubate with NovoLink® polymer for 30 minutes.
Wash slides in TBS for 2 × 5 minutes with gentle rocking.
Develop peroxydase activity with DAB working solution for 5 minutes.
Wash slides in water.
Counterstain with hematein.
Wash slides in water for 5 minutes.
Dehydrate, clear and mount the slides.
Attack muscle samples by KOH 5% without heating to destroy vegetal tissues while preserving pollen grains.
Centrifuge and rinse the sample.
Dilute final dried residue within glycerol to a total volume of 100 μl.
Separate diluted residue into two parts of 50 μl each, place between slides and cover glasses.
Examine both slides completely at an optical microscope (x250).
Each pollen grain is observed at magnification ×1000 for detailed examination and identification.
Mineralize samples with hot concentrated nitric acid.
Dilute mineralized samples with ultra pure water to obtain a final volume of 0.5 mL.
Perform fast semi-quantitative analysis of all elements using ICP-MS TotalQuant method.
Quantitatively measure Pb, Sn, Sb, Cu, Bi, Hg by ICP-MS.
Quantitatively measure Fe, Ca and Al by ICP-OES.
Carry out molecular analysis on at least two 0.5 mg samples.
Use SPME to trap organic volatile compounds from the samples.
Perform GC/MS analysis to identify trapped compounds.
Place samples directly into a glass liner in the chromatograph injector.
Desorb organic components at 300°C for five minutes.
